subject: info-algn
title: INFO.ALGN.------STF.
description: Chart on book p. 89 ((AF)D-17). INFO-ALGN (information alignment) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; STF (source transfer) is the partner. From the subject: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", and ATTN (attraction), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From APP-RDEF: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From ATTN: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and AF-TD (affinity tendencies), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From AF-TD: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and CUL-INFO-B. From T-C-IMP: TR-DEF (trans-definition). From CUL-INFO-B: POL-P (political policies) and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From POL-P: RT-DY (reality dynamics).
